title: 7 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Food
summary: Gary Larson’s comic strip The Far Side could star anything, even food. Here are the 7 funniest food jokes from The Far Side
content: Anything can be the star of a Far Side comic . While most of them featured stupid humans or talking animals as their main characters, the surrealist streak in cartoonist Gary Larson sometimes gave life to inanimate objects as well. For example, there’s a strip where a jogger tells a living pair of scissors that they can no longer run together. And if scissors can be alive in The Far Side comics, just about anything can, including food.

title: 8 Classic PlayStation Games That Are Barely Playable Today
summary: From Tomb Raider to Silent Hill, eight classic PlayStation games whose tank controls, cameras, or lost code make them hard to play today
content: If you’ve ever watched someone play an old PlayStation game and wondered why their character keeps spinning around in circles, congratulations, you’ve already met tank controls. If you’re unfamiliar, here’s your quick introduction: With tank controls, pressing up moves your character forward in whatever direction they’re facing, and pressing left or right only rotates them, so with the stick alone, you can’t sidestep or turn on a dime. That’s manageable in a hallway. It’s much less so when you’re sneaking past a guard, lining up a shot, or timing a leap across a pit, which is why the same scheme caused trouble in just about every genre during the PS1 era. These eight classic games are the hardest to go back to, whether the culprit is tank controls or something else entirely.

title: 63 Years Later, CBS's Legendary 70-Episode Series Still Has the Only Vampire Worth Watching
summary: The 1964 sitcom The Munsters is still a comey classic, with Grandpa Munster as its funniest character. Here are the five best epsiodes.
content: It’s Fangsgiving here at Polygon, our Thanksgiving celebration of stories about fanged creatures of all types and especially vampires . I didn't want to be left out, but, to be honest, I always thought vampires were kind of dumb. They're a horror movie staple, but they’re rarely all that scary. There’s usually a romantic element to their stories that I also find tiresome . Perhaps I’ve just never seen the right vampire movies, but overall I find vampires to be pretty lame.
